citations.text: When the ambulance staff, or the staff at a primary care clinic, identified a patient who met the inclusion criteria, a senior MÄVA doctor or the on-call doctor was contacted via telephone. If the MÄVA doctor agreed that the patient fulfilled the inclusion criteria, and there was a bed available at MÄVA, the patient was included in the intervention group and admitted directly to MÄVA without passing through the emergency room. In case of unavailability of a bed on the MÄVA wards, the patient was included in the control group and admitted to a conventional acute medical care unit via the emergency room.

1.1.reasoning: Allocation was based on bed availability, not on a chance mechanism.
